issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) should return a double (use double precision for net cost), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This type mismatch between the spec and the solution can confuse students about the expected return type and precision for price calculations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Either update the problem statement/UML to specify an int return type (if integer prices are intended), or change the implementation to return a double and perform price calculations using double precision. If choosing double, modify SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice signature to return double and ensure summation uses double arithmetic (and update any tests if they expect integers).
